notes: Search modal at its empty state: the panel is drawn and the PlayerBar follows it. The modal frame is modalBounds() at stageWidth 1728 -> {864, 122, 805, 836}; every ROI below is one absolute stage rectangle derived from that origin plus the panel-relative constants in NativeHudSearch.cpp:8-13, never a relative value pasted in as absolute. Search tab and row hits are not frozen because their widths come from runtime glyph metrics (Glyphs.cpp:286-311); the 540-wide tab band is a hand-picked comparison window, not a Qt output rect.
